report.summary: All 26 tests errored in the shared session fixture `base_url` (tests/conftest.py:65) because the app server process exited with code 1 before answering /health, so none of the tests reached their assertions. The application code shows no defect that would explain this, so start by running `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` from the repo root in the same venv to get the real startup traceback, which the fixture discards.

causes.title: Uvicorn app process exits with code 1 during session startup in the test environment
causes.explanation: The `base_url` fixture starts the app as a subprocess (`python -m uvicorn app.main:app`) and polls /health. The process exited with code 1 before it became ready, so `_wait_until_up` raised. Because `base_url` is session-scoped, one startup failure fails every test that uses it. The app's own code looks loadable: app/main.py creates the schema at import with `sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)` and the imports are standard. The likely environment causes are a venv missing a dependency (`No module named uvicorn` or fastapi exits with code 1), a DB_PATH or APP_DB_PATH that cannot be written, or an import-time error from the local setup. The run was on Windows (venv under C:\Users\IvanPosavec\Documents\qa-lab), while the CI workflow runs on ubuntu-latest, so this looks like a local environment problem. The fixture passes `stdout`/`stderr` through to the console and does not capture them, so the report has no traceback. Evidence is limited to the exit code and this error text; the actual cause is not in the logs.
evidence: tests/conftest.py:35: raise RuntimeError(f"App exited early with code {proc.returncode}")
tests/conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--port", str(port), "--log-level", "warning"], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with no stdout/stderr capture
app/main.py:20 DB_PATH = os.environ.get("DB_PATH", "bookshelf.db"); app/main.py:57-58 schema created at import time via `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)`
requirements.txt lists fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2, python-multipart; no code path in the repo sets APP_DB_PATH or DB_PATH outside conftest
causes.suggested_fix: Run the app command by hand in the same venv from the repo root and read the traceback. Then fix the cause it shows, most likely by running `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt` in that venv or by pointing APP_DB_PATH at a writable location. To keep future failures diagnosable, change the fixture to capture the child's stderr (for example, redirect to a log file under tmp_path) and include its tail in the RuntimeError message.
